messages.content: why i am so greedy day by day

Priya, greed can be a tough cycle to break, but recognizing it is the first step 🙏. Remember, true fulfillment comes from within, not from external things - try to cultivate a sense of inner peace through self-reflection 🧘‍♂️. Focus on what truly brings you joy and let go of the rest, you've got this 💪! ✨
